observed_events.description: A tined fork is held and used in the red single-handle saucepan;2553 exposes tines and2554 shows in-pan stirring.
The wearer removes cooked rice from the microwave, sets it down, opens a cutlery drawer and rinses hands during the same meal preparation. These are not extra requested purchases.
A bowl-head spoon is held near the same saucepan at2599 and actually stirs it at2602 and2604. The follow-up adds this basic type and retains the first type.

unsupported_claims: Exact retail identity, brand, dimensions, material and serving-versus-table size are not matching conditions.

screening.real_user_need: Restock separate same-type cutlery packs after using two utensils during one meal preparation.
screening.scope_note: New independent recording relative to formal200; explicit user-origin augment, not world-triggered replacement.
screening.proposed_instruction: Add one pack of the same basic type of cutlery as the one I'm using in this saucepan. Any brand, size or material is fine. The pack should contain only that type of cutlery, not a mixed set or a combination multitool.

supported_claims.text: A tined fork works in the saucepan before a bowl-head spoon is used in the same saucepan. Only basic cutlery type is matched.

sensitivity_review.reason: Visual utensil forms determine the two purchases; new wording, continuous window and spoon boundary await independent review.

construct.research_question: Can the agent add the later visually grounded cutlery type while retaining the earlier requested pack?
construct.belief_before: One same-type pack matching the first saucepan utensil is requested.
construct.belief_after: A separate pack matching the later saucepan utensil is also requested; the first remains required.
construct.required_behavior_change: Retain the first pack and add one separate pack of the later basic type.
construct.no_update_failure: Only a first-type pack misses the added request.
construct.overupdate_failure: Replacing the first pack, or using a mixed set, misses two separate same-type packs.
construct.visual_dependency_claim: The requests do not name either type. Initial tines and later spoon bowl, both in saucepan use, determine shopping roles. No exact brand, material or size is inferable as mandatory.

instructions.a: Add one pack of the same basic type of cutlery as the one I'm using in this saucepan. Any brand, size or material is fine. The pack should contain only that type of cutlery, not a mixed set or a combination multitool.
instructions.b: Also add one pack of the other type of cutlery I'm using in the saucepan now. Keep the first pack.
instructions.bundled: Add one pack matching each of the two basic types of cutlery I use in this saucepan: the one used first and the one used afterwards. Any brand, size or material is fine. Each pack must contain only its own cutlery type, not a mixed set or a combination multitool.

observed.why: Wearer explicitly adds the current other type and retains the first pack; scene appearance alone does not authorize another purchase.
